title: Scrubbed clip-path doorway into a section
summary: A veil cut by one `polygon(evenodd, frame…, hole…)` whose hole a scrubbed `{ p }` proxy grows from `20% × 24%` to the full frame over a `200svh` sticky stage (`top top` → `bottom bottom`, no pin) while two labels part `±50vw`; a statement revealed through `circle(p × 150% at 50% 120%)` with a later, longer phone window; no clip at all under reduced motion or static
variants: even-odd polygon hole in a veil, scrubbed open over a sticky stage while two labels part ±50 vw (this, default)
statement revealed through circle(p × 150% at 50% 120%), with a later, longer window on phones (this)
scrub: 1 for a soft catch-up instead of scrub: true; or a rounded hole via an SVG path() with two subpaths
